Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + conversational insights). Came in via hosted API POC (Jan-Feb) — happy with quality but unpredictable tail latency for spikes. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

Timeline & key touchpoints:
- 2026-01-15: initial signup, small hosted API POC (chat + semantic search) — basic integration done by eng team.
- 2026-02-02: demo w/ AE + SE (Ava, Diego) — showed model routing + streaming. Customer: "Hosted was fast to start but noisy at spike times".
- 2026-02-18: perf run uncovered 95th pctl latency spikes at 350-420ms under burst; average tokens cost higher than expected.
- 2026-02-28: pricing review call — mid-market pricing sensitivity noted; wants committed reserved pricing for predictable monthlies. Linked pricing deck.
- 2026-03-01: security questionnaire returned; asked for SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML flow diagram, KMS integration notes (tickets opened RDW-1123, RDW-1187). Fireflies IDs attached.
- 2026-03-05: SE-run architecture sync — agreed on Dedicated POC scope: 2-week canary with 2 regions (us-east1 + europe-west1), canary will run 10% of traffic ramp to 50% over 48h.

POC / Canary plan (agreed in principle):
- Objective: validate Dedicated throughput & SLOs, verify canary routing, and test fallback/rollback automation.
- Targets: p95 latency target 150ms (hard), preferred 50-100ms; throughput target 150 req/s steady; tail error rate <1.5%.
- Routing plan: traffic split via API Gateway -> canary Dedicated pool (model variant A) for subset; fallback to hosted_api (same model) on error or elevated latency.
- Model variants: primary = quantized 8-bit variant (lower-cost, slightly lower quality), fallback = full fp16 variant hosted or smaller-context optimized model. SE notes: "keep KV cache warm, prefix caching for sessioned flows."
- Region failover: primary region us-east1, secondary europe-west1 for EU tenants; automatic failover if >5% requests hit impaired nodes for >3 minutes.
- Rollback triggers: p95 latency >200ms for 10min OR error rate >2% OR observed quality regression on small eval set. Rollback action: immediate traffic redirect to hosted_api + notify on-call SE.
- Observability: enable token-level cost logging, per-route latency dashboards, and eval hooks to run 50 sample prompts hourly for quality regression detection.

Current concerns / customer quotes:
- "We need a clear SLA for tail latency before we commit to dedicated pricing."
- Wants clarity on cost delta for quantized vs fp16 variants and the effect on token-level unit economics.
- Security wants written confirmation on data residency partitioning for EU customer subset.

- SE (Diego) to share canary runbook and rollback playbook by 2026-03-15.
- Security to upload SOC2 package and KMS integration guide to Drive link.
